name: HIP 39017

planets.name: b
planets.note: Substellar companion (massive planet or low-mass brown dwarf, L/T transition spectral type) at ~0.4" (~22-24 au) projected separation; dynamical mass ~30 M_Jup (weighted estimate ~23.6 M_Jup), luminosity-based mass ~13.8 M_Jup. Detected via HGCA astrometric acceleration of the host.

paper.title: Direct-imaging Discovery of a Substellar Companion Orbiting the Accelerating Variable Star, HIP 39017

notes: HIP 39017 is a young (≲115 Myr), gamma Doradus-type pulsating variable star showing HGCA astrometric acceleration, which motivated the imaging search that found companion b. The paper describes b as a 'massive planet or low-mass brown dwarf' with an L/T transition spectrum; tagged here with method imaging per atlas convention.
